Opening hours and how to find us

Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair is Shop 81 on the ground floor of Pacific Fair Shopping Centre in Broadbeach, on the north-eastern side of the centre next to Proud Smile. We’re open 7 days and until 9pm on Thursdays, with 4 hours of free parking at the centre and the Broadbeach South light rail stop right out the front.

Where is the pharmacy inside Pacific Fair?

You’ll find us on the ground floor, next to Proud Smile on our right, with the outdoor entrance from the river on our left. Once you’re inside, the prescription counter is on the left at the very back of the store, and Help Medical is on the right-hand side as you walk in.

Where should I park?

Pacific Fair offers 4 hours of free parking each day, and complimentary all-day parking when you spend over $300 in the centre. Entry and exit are ticketless: a camera reads your number plate, so remember your plate if you’re staying longer than 4 hours. Free all-day parking is available with an accessible parking permit.

  • Car park below us: from the Gold Coast Highway, cross the bridge into Pacific Fair and turn right into the car park beneath the north-eastern side of the centre.
  • Undercover rooftop parking: head to the north-eastern side of the centre and park on the undercover rooftop level above us.

For car park maps, rates beyond 4 hours and accessible parking, see Pacific Fair’s parking page.

How do I get there by light rail or bus?

Take the G:link light rail to Broadbeach South station, on the Gold Coast Highway right out the front of Pacific Fair. It’s a short walk into the centre, and we’re close to the Gold Coast Highway side. Many bus routes also stop at Broadbeach South and at the Pacific Fair bus interchange on Hooker Boulevard. Plan your trip with Translink.

Is the store accessible?

  • Level, step-free entrance from the centre.
  • Accessible parking close to the north-eastern entrances, and free all-day parking with a permit.
  • Accessible toilets and parents’ rooms in Pacific Fair.
  • A private consultation room for vaccinations and pharmacist consultations.

Questions before you visit?

Call us on (07) 5592 2099 or send us an email.

Common questions

Are you open on Sundays?

Yes, we’re open 7 days a week, including Sundays. Our full hours are listed on this page; check our Google listing for public holiday hours before you visit.

Which entrance is closest to the pharmacy?

We’re on the ground floor on the north-eastern side of Pacific Fair, near the outdoor entrance from the river and next to Proud Smile. Park in the car park beneath us or the undercover rooftop above us and you’re a short walk away.

Is parking free?

Yes, for the first 4 hours each day, and all day if you spend over $300 in the centre. Entry and exit are ticketless: a camera reads your number plate. See Pacific Fair’s parking page for rates beyond 4 hours and accessible parking.

Is the store wheelchair accessible?

Yes. The store has a level, step-free entrance from the centre and accessible parking nearby. Pacific Fair has accessible toilets and parents’ rooms. Call us if you’d like help planning your visit.

How do I get there by public transport?

Take the G:link light rail to Broadbeach South station, right out the front of Pacific Fair, or a bus to the Pacific Fair interchange on Hooker Boulevard. Plan your trip with Translink, then walk in to the ground floor.
